name: ERTH 4735
title: Introduction to Ground Water Hydrology
description: (Also offered as NRE 4135.) Basic hydrologic principles with emphasis on ground water flow and quality, geologic relationships, quantitative analysis and field methods. Occasional field trips.
requirement_description: Open to juniors or higher. Recommended preparation: ERTH 1050, or both ERTH 1052 and one of ERTH 1010, 1051, 1055, or 1070. Not open for credit to students who have passed ERTH 5735.
